Trump's Approach to China's Xi Jinping Under Scrutiny

Reports indicate that Donald Trump, during his presidency, adopted a lenient stance towards Chinese President Xi Jinping on various issues, including allegations of China aiding Iran. Trump reportedly stated that Xi had behaved 'reasonably well.' This approach has been linked to China's role in limiting oil prices, which some outlets suggest benefited the US economy, allowing it to 'free-ride off Beijing.' Despite past criticisms of China, Trump's administration was characterized by hospitality towards Xi.
